name: boj_list_series
description:
List the Japanese series the boj_ tools read, with their shorthand id, source (FRED or IMF), code and label. A built-in list; no network call and no API key.
Returns: category, count, source and series (id, code, fred_code for FRED series, source, label).
Inputs (none required): category (rates, fx, money, prices, economy or all; default all).
Fetch a series with the matching tool: boj_get_jgb_yield, boj_get_policy_rate, boj_get_exchange_rate, boj_get_money_supply, boj_get_inflation, boj_get_economic_indicator.
Example: {"category": "rates"}
